Energy-manager input
The W11 can receive a dynamic current setpoint over Modbus TCP from a compatible energy manager or

Operating range
Solar-surplus mode varies charging from approximately 1.4 kW single-phase equivalent control up to the
configured 11 kW maximum, subject to site configuration.
HelioSync integration
Protocol profile HS-EV-2 is compatible with the HelioSync I10 gateway when both devices use firmware listed in
their current guides.
Grid supplement
When the site setting permits grid import, the grid supplies any difference between photovoltaic output,
household demand and the requested charging power. The inverter's PV output alone does not necessarily cap
wallbox output.
Solar-surplus charging still uses the site's AC distribution system, protective devices and wallbox. It is not a direct
panel-to-vehicle connection.
